caveats.en: Elgato marks Camera Hub as 'does not work: software installation fails' on Windows on Arm. Facecam hardware still works as a standard webcam in other apps.
caveats.zh-TW: Elgato 將 Camera Hub 標示為「無法使用：軟體安裝失敗」。Facecam 硬體本身仍可在其他 App 中當一般網路攝影機使用。
